lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in approximately six observable vertical columns, with vertical spacing of 5 to 7 spots per column in the region posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a semi-regular grid of anchor nodes across the visible mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance edges above and low-intensity shadow troughs below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an attached commensal organism (remora) on the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
